name: ICsprout55 H7CH 7-track (1.2V core)

cap_options.name: moscap
cap_options.notes: 1.2 V core oxide, non-linear C(V); density is the flat-band minimum (depleted channel), density_typ is the peak. A_C (%*um) is still an assumption: the vendor mismatch hooks are HSpice agauss expressions and the flattened deck zeroes them.

measurement.method: 1 MHz small-signal gate current, C = |Im(I(Vg))|/(2*pi*f), both devices with S/D/bulk on FL and the gate on VSH
measurement.note: density_ff_um2 is the flat-band minimum (depleted channel, conservative for area); density_typ_ff_um2 is the peak. ac_pct_um is NOT measured: the vendor mismatch hooks are HSpice agauss expressions and the flat deck zeroes them.

cap_options.name: mom
cap_options.notes: vendor mom_2t behavioral model at libs.tech/spice/foundry/ngspice/mom/mom.ckt; density and Pelgrom are still estimates. The taped-out CDAC uses moscap units, not this device.

measurement.method: 10 mV across the closed TG at Vg=rail, 11 input points; off-cap from the AC current into the DAC-side node with the gate off
measurement.note: ron_ohm is the worst point over the input range, at mid-rail where both devices have minimum overdrive. hvt at 1.2 V is weak there: widening to the 9 um bin edge is the cheap lever, a lower-VT device or a bootstrap is the real one. The width study records the Ron/off-cap trade.

bootstrapped.notes: not measured in this pass; the array uses the transmission gate. A bootstrap removes the mid-rail overdrive collapse the TG curve shows.

measurement.method: systematic offset by bisection over +-40 mV (9 iterations); delay = clk 50 % to the |outp-outn| = VDD/2 split at a 10 mV differential (delay_probe.delay_out50_ns is the single-ended diagnostic)
measurement.note: offset is systematic only -- every device is nominal, so this is the topology/sizing offset, not a distribution. sigma_uv still needs the vendor agauss mismatch hooks; Xyce 7.10 .noise returns zeros, so no noise number.

ramp.notes: single-slope ramp: step-to-step linearity and the ramp-buffer settling are estimates; the clock ceiling is the profile's digital ceiling. There is no cap array, so DNL comes from the ramp, not from Pelgrom mismatch.

sdm.notes: second-order 1-bit switched-cap loop. loading_db is the measured gap between the linearized NTF bound and the L1 bitstream simulation at 0.5 FS (9.0 dB, flat over OSR 16..64); it is not a stability margin estimate. Integrator GBW is an estimate. The decimator does not exist, so the reported ENOB assumes an ideal one.

measurement.note: L3 transistor-sparse DCO table on the ICS55 h7cr macro (27-point coarse/mid/fine grid, TT only). Full measured span 703.2..1896.9 MHz. The bank is DIGITALLY controlled: no analog tuning port was measured, so KVCO here is span/VFS and any analog-control nonlinearity is an assumption. The measured coarse characteristic is strongly nonlinear (1896.9/1002.7/759.3 MHz at coarse 0/8/15), so an open-loop transfer needs the coarse bank as a calibration map. No PEX/PVT/jitter signoff.
measurement.curvature_pct_basis: assumption: 4k x(1-x) tuning deviation fitted to nothing; flagged as unverified

sim.xyce_recipe: python3 gen/analog/deck.py --ics55-xyce --out gen/outputs/deck/ics55_tt.spice --devices nm1p2_hvt_lp pm1p2_hvt_lp nm1p2_svt_lp pm1p2_svt_lp --w-um 1 --l-um 0.06

xyce_verified.model: BSIM4 level 54. hvt bins nm1p2_hvt_lp_core.6 / pm1p2_hvt_lp_core.7 (L 54..72 nm, W 0.9..9.09 um); svt/lvt are single interpolated cards resolved numerically at the requested W/L.
xyce_verified.measurement: W=1 um, L=60 nm, |Vd|=|Vg|=1.2 V: hvt nmos 393 uA / pmos 203 uA; svt nmos 559 uA / pmos 309 uA. Analog leaves measured at the same size with gen/analog/measure_xyce.py (moscap C(V), TG Ron/Coff, comparator delay).
xyce_verified.note: generated from model_wrapper1_hsp.lib .LIB tt + mos/*.mdl. One bin per binned device; d*_<device> deltas and <device>_*_retgt hooks are 0 in tt; sigma_mis_a..d and prelayout are declared global. The svt/lvt cards use HSpice select6/selectp7/evalbin macros that Xyce cannot expand, so gen/analog/hspice_expr.py evaluates them: those cards are geometry-locked to the (W, L) the deck was built with. Xyce warns the card declares BSIM4 4.5 and uses its oldest supported version (4.6.1). The mismatch hooks (d*_<dev>_mis / _mismatch) are baked to zero so the deck is nominal-only; no statistical run is possible from it.

sim.license_note: vendor model data, educational/research evaluation only; not released PDK collateral and not usable for signoff or production

digital_ceiling_source: adpll_gen pdk_profiles.json ics55 signoff_mhz (PEX-cap + sparse L3; no PVT/jitter signoff)
maturity: LibreLane config and magic tech present; 1.4um rows; vendor models are evaluation-only

analog.notes: device names verified against model_wrapper1_hsp.lib, and deck.py --ics55-xyce flattens the tt corner into a bare-model deck that Xyce 7.10 runs. The vendor subckt form still cannot run in Xyce (HSpice select6/selectp7/evalbin macros), so macro_gen's subckt output remains fail-closed: generation stays 'scaffold'. Metrics measured with measure_xyce.py at the drawn leaf geometry (W=1 um, L=60 nm): moscap density, TG Ron/Coff, comparator delay. A_C and comparator sigma_uv are still assumptions (vendor statistical hooks are agauss-only; Xyce .noise returns zeros).
